messages.en: Did you catch that performance earlier?
Yeah! It was great. I want to see it again.
Our team's defence is getting stronger.
True. But we still need to keep a closer eye on the left flank.

senses.en_definition: Coming before all others in order or sequence.
Happening for the first time; with no previous occurrence.
Used to introduce the first point or step in a sequence.

messages.en: I can't wait to go to Penang this weekend. It'll be my first time there!
Really? I'll show you around when we get there. What food do you want to try?
I want to try Penang laksa first. I'll leave the rest up to you—you know the place better.

senses.en_definition: An event in which individuals or teams compete to win, such as a contest, match or race.
Rivalry between people or groups striving for success or an advantage.
(Uncommon) A comparison between two or more things.

messages.en: Let's enter that singing competition. There's a duet category, so we can enter together.
I'd love to, but will we have enough time to practise? Registration closes next week.
We should have time, I reckon. Let's pick that song we always sing, so we won't have to learn it from scratch.
